dev-host-amazon-kvm-xfs.cpu: 8 vCPU, AMD EPYC 7571 under Amazon KVM

workload.read_pattern: one fetch after every ten metric writes
workload.correctness: a classic oracle is updated after every round; all metrics are checked after reopen and a sampled set is checked after compaction/reopen

interpretation.cpu_us_point: process user plus system CPU divided by committed input points
interpretation.allocated_bytes: final on-disk allocated bytes from the maintenance log
interpretation.allocated_b_per_point: Go TotalAlloc delta divided by committed input points during the timed loop
interpretation.rss_kib: process maximum RSS reported after the timed loop
interpretation.cache_budget: Pebble reserves active memtable bytes from its configured cache. Cache MiB therefore needs block-cache headroom beyond memtables and is not an RSS limit.
interpretation.file_backend_cache: The cwhisper-ooo file backend does not use the Pebble cache option; its logged cache value is retained only as run configuration context.

caveats: The workload uses repeated synthetic values (timestamp modulo 101), not a captured production stream.
These results do not establish production latency, throughput, memory limits, or deployment safety.
The matched late-write cwhisper-ooo and pebble-chunks results are included.
Scale tests fully compact Pebble but merge file OOO sidecars only for sampled metrics; the separate fully-merged file probe is allocation-only and excluded from the timing CSV.

validation.race: go test -p 4 -race -timeout 30m ./...: all packages passed except helper/TestThrottleChan; unchanged baseline reproduced that timing failure, current focused test passed 3/3
validation.scope: Final Go source and dependency files matched the tested integration source; no commit, push or deployment.
